```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.colors import ListedColormap, BoundaryNorm
from matplotlib.patches import Patch, Rectangle
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D

root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():
    if root==root.parent:raise RuntimeError('No es troba el projecte')
    root=root.parent
out=root/'assets/img/generated/intervisibilitat.svg'
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':14,'svg.fonttype':'none'})
receptors=np.array([[100,700],[100,400],[100,100],[100,-100]])
targets=np.array([[800,700],[800,400],[800,100]])
screens=[(500,500,40,45),(650,20,90,250),(200,0,100,300)]
def visible(a,b):
    t=np.linspace(0,1,1001)
    xy=a[None,:]+t[:,None]*(b-a)[None,:]
    return int(not any(np.any((xy[:,0]>=x)&(xy[:,0]<=x+w)&(xy[:,1]>=y)&(xy[:,1]<=y+h))
                       for x,y,w,h in screens))
matrix=np.array([[visible(r,p) for p in targets] if r[1]>=0 else [-1]*3 for r in receptors])
assert np.array_equal(matrix,[[1,0,0],[1,1,0],[0,0,0],[-1,-1,-1]])
assert matrix[:3].sum()==3 and (matrix[:3].sum(axis=1)>0).sum()==2
colors=['#d7d7d7','#f3ede1','#39734d']
fig,(map_ax,ax)=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(10.2,5.9),layout='constrained',gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1.35,1]})
map_ax.add_patch(Rectangle((0,-180),950,180,facecolor=colors[0],edgecolor='none'))
for i,r in enumerate(receptors[:3]):
    for j,p in enumerate(targets):
        yes=matrix[i,j]==1
        map_ax.plot([r[0],p[0]],[r[1],p[1]],color='#39734d' if yes else '#b6603a',
                    ls='-' if yes else '--',lw=2.1 if yes else 1,alpha=1 if yes else .5,zorder=1)
for x,y,w,h in screens:
    map_ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x,y),w,h,facecolor='#6d7478',edgecolor='white',zorder=3))
for i,(x,y) in enumerate(receptors,1):
    map_ax.scatter([x],[y],s=60,color='#003366',zorder=4)
    map_ax.text(x-28,y+16,f'R{i}',ha='right',fontsize=14,color='#003366',weight='bold')
for j,(x,y) in enumerate(targets,1):
    map_ax.scatter([x],[y],s=70,marker='^',color='#b55b24',zorder=4)
    map_ax.text(x+25,y+16,f'P{j}',fontsize=14,color='#91451a',weight='bold')
map_ax.text(550,-110,'Fora de l’àmbit',ha='center',fontsize=13)
map_ax.set(xlim=(0,950),ylim=(-180,850),aspect='equal',xticks=[],yticks=[],
           title='A · Qui mira i cap a on?')
map_ax.set_xlabel('Vista en planta · Pantalles opaques',fontsize=13)
ax.imshow(matrix,cmap=ListedColormap(colors),norm=BoundaryNorm([-1.5,-.5,.5,1.5],3),aspect='auto')
for (y,x),value in np.ndenumerate(matrix):
    ax.text(x,y,'—' if value==-1 else str(value),ha='center',va='center',fontsize=21,
            color='white' if value==1 else '#333333')
ax.set(xticks=range(3),xticklabels=['P1','P2','P3'],yticks=range(4),
        yticklabels=['R1','R2','R3','R4'])
ax.set_title('B · Taula d’intervisibilitat',pad=20)
ax.set_xlabel('Columnes: punts observats',labelpad=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Files: llocs des d’on es mira',labelpad=10)
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(-.5,3,1),minor=True);ax.set_yticks(np.arange(-.5,4,1),minor=True)
ax.grid(which='minor',color='white',lw=3);ax.tick_params(which='both',length=0)
fig.legend(handles=[Patch(facecolor=colors[2],label='1 · Hi ha línia de visió'),
                    Patch(facecolor=colors[1],edgecolor='#999999',label='0 · Ocult'),
                    Patch(facecolor=colors[0],label='— · No calculat')],
           loc='outside lower center',ncol=3,frameon=False,fontsize=14)
for spine in ax.spines.values():spine.set_visible(False)
fig.savefig(out,facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None})
plt.close(fig)
```
